tasks.title: Reviewer targets .ralph/reviews/round-<N>.md with directory-scoped allowlist
tasks.description:
Point the post-task reviewer at a per-round review file and fix the permission rule structurally. All changes in src/post-task-reviewer.ts (plus its tests). TDD: update/extend test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts first.

1. In spawnPostTaskReviewer (src/post-task-reviewer.ts): read the current planning round via getRound(dataDir) from ./task-counter, mkdirSync(path.join(dataDir, 'reviews'), { recursive: true }), and compute the absolute target path <dataDir>/reviews/round-<N>.md. The reviewer agent must never compute the round or path itself.
2. Inject the exact target file path into the user prompt: buildPostTaskReviewUserPrompt currently hardcodes 'append your findings to `.ralph/review-post.md`' (line ~61). Add a reviewFilePath (absolute path string) option to buildPostTaskReviewUserPrompt and reference it in that closing instruction instead. spawnPostTaskReviewer passes the computed path.
3. Replace the single-file permission rule (lines ~124-130): reviewFileRule becomes a directory glob `/${projectRoot}/.ralph/reviews/**` used in both Edit(...) and Write(...) of --allowedTools. KEEP the existing code comment explaining why the path must be absolute (reviewer cd's into service dirs; relative rules silently deny in -p mode, observed 2026-07-11) — update it to reflect the glob.
4. runPostTaskReview needs no signature change (it already passes dataDir through to spawnPostTaskReviewer).

Tests (test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts): (a) update the existing --allowedTools assertion at line ~265 to expect Edit(/<root>/.ralph/reviews/**),Write(/<root>/.ralph/reviews/**); (b) spawnPostTaskReviewer creates .ralph/reviews/ when missing; (c) the user prompt contains .ralph/reviews/round-1.md when state.json has no round (lazy seed — pre-plan reviews land in round-1.md) and round-<N>.md when state.json has round: N; (d) buildPostTaskReviewUserPrompt output contains the injected path and no review-post.md mention.
tasks.notes:
# Task #28: Reviewer targets .ralph/reviews/round-<N>.md with directory-scoped allowlist

## What changed

`src/post-task-reviewer.ts`:
- Imported `mkdirSync` from `fs`, `path`, and `getRound` from `./task-counter`.
- `buildPostTaskReviewUserPrompt` now takes a required `reviewFilePath: string` option and references it in the closing instruction (`append your findings to \`${reviewFilePath}\``) instead of the hardcoded `.ralph/review-post.md`.
- `spawnPostTaskReviewer` now (CLI-owned, never the agent):
  - `const round = getRound(dataDir)` — lazy seed means pre-plan reviews get round 1.
  - `mkdirSync(path.join(dataDir, 'reviews'), { recursive: true })`.
  - Computes absolute `reviewFilePath = <dataDir>/reviews/round-<N>.md` and passes it into `buildPostTaskReviewUserPrompt`.
  - `reviewFileRule` changed from single file `/${projectRoot}/.ralph/review-post.md` to directory glob `/${projectRoot}/.ralph/reviews/**`, used in both `Edit(...)` and `Write(...)` of `--allowedTools`. Kept + updated the absolute-path comment (reviewer cd's into service dirs; relative rules silently deny in -p mode, observed 2026-07-11).
- `runPostTaskReview` unchanged (already threads `dataDir` through). `src/commands/run.ts` needed no change — it already passes `dataDir` at line ~605.

## Tests (test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts) — TDD red→green
- Updated `--allowedTools` assertion to expect `Edit(/<root>/.ralph/reviews/**),Write(/<root>/.ralph/reviews/**)`.
- Added: `creates .ralph/reviews/ directory when missing` (uses `existsSync`).
- Added: prompt targets `round-1.md` when no state.json (lazy seed) and `round-4.md` when `state.json` has `round: 4`.
- Added (buildPostTaskReviewUserPrompt): references injected `reviewFilePath` and asserts prompt does NOT contain `review-post.md`.
- Ran tests first → 5 failed (red), then implemented → 31 pass (green).

## Verification
- `bun test test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts` → 31 pass, 0 fail (the `fatal: not a git repository` line is expected stderr from an existing getGitDiff test).
- `bun test` → 730 pass, 0 fail.
- `bun run build` → compiles clean.

## Notes for next agent
- `getRound` is a pure read (never mutates/creates state.json); the round is bumped only by `ralph plan` (task #27). So all post-task reviews within one planning round append to the same `round-<N>.md`.
- The old `.ralph/review-post.md` file is no longer written; existing one in the repo is now stale/orphaned (left untouched — not in scope).

tasks.title: Rewrite post-task-reviewer agent prompt for injected file path
tasks.description:
Update the reviewer agent definition so its output target is the file path given in its user prompt, not a hardcoded filename. IMPORTANT: agent definitions live in the SOURCE directory agents/ at the repo root — ralph init installs them into target projects' .claude/. Edit the source file agents/post-task-reviewer.md, then sync this repo's own installed copy .claude/agents/post-task-reviewer.md so the two files are identical.

Changes in agents/post-task-reviewer.md:
1. Frontmatter description (line 3): currently '...writes results to review-post.md.' — reword to say it appends results to the per-round review file specified in its prompt (keep internal: true).
2. Line ~11: 'You may only write to `.ralph/review-post.md`' — change to: you may only write to the review file whose path is given in your user prompt; never modify `.ralph/tasks.json`.
3. Output Format section (line ~42): 'Append your review to `.ralph/review-post.md` using the Edit tool' — change to append to the file path given in the user prompt (Edit if it exists, Write to create it).
4. Keep the entire existing review format unchanged: coverage ASCII tree with [DONE]/[PARTIAL]/[GAP], Files Changed, Gaps, Regression Risks, Verdict CLEAN | HAS_GAPS | HAS_RISKS.
5. Verify no review-post.md mention remains in either copy (grep both files).

This is a markdown/prompt-only task; run the full test suite as a regression check.

tasks.title: Delete legacy review-post.md and update docs
tasks.description:
Remove the legacy single-file review log and update all documentation for the per-round system.

1. `git rm .ralph/review-post.md` (git history preserves it — do not archive or copy it anywhere).
2. CLAUDE.md updates: (a) in the 'Per-project data layout' tree, add `.ralph/reviews/` ('round-<N>.md — per-planning-round post-task review logs') and update the state.json comment from '{ "nextTaskId": N }' to include the round field, e.g. '{ "nextTaskId": N, "round": R }'; (b) in the Agent workflow section, update the sentence about the post-task reviewer running 'with a path-scoped allowlist that excludes .ralph/tasks.json' to describe the directory-scoped rule covering .ralph/reviews/**; (c) mention that `ralph plan` bumps the round counter.
3. README.md updates: line ~300's data-layout tree entry for state.json ('Monotonic task-ID counter — never reuses IDs') — extend for the round counter, and add the reviews/ directory to that tree.
4. Scrub any remaining `review-post.md` references repo-wide: `grep -rn review-post . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git` must return no hits in source, tests, agents/, .claude/, or docs (checks test/commands/init.test.ts, test/commands/plan.test.ts, test/agent-prompt.test.ts among others; as of planning, those three had no references — verify nothing regressed).
5. Run the full suite to confirm nothing referenced the deleted file.

Docs-and-deletion task; no new unit tests required beyond the grep gate and the full suite.
